the_thing_worth_reading_twice: A schedule that never ran looked healthy for its entire life because something else kept its liveness mark fresh. Every hour, a lap dispatched the lane by hand, the answer file moved, and the heartbeat read that as the cron working. The mark was real, the freshness was real, and the conclusion drawn from them was false — because the thing being watched and the thing doing the moving were two different mechanisms. WHEN A DETECTOR IS GREEN, ASK WHAT WOULD HAVE TO STOP FOR IT TO GO RED, AND CHECK THAT IT IS THE THING YOU CARE ABOUT. Here it was not, and the fix was not a better detector but a mark only the scheduled run could move.
